session_note: Oregon's 2026 session is the constitutionally-limited even-year short session (Oregon Constitution Art. IV, Sec. 10, capped at 35 days). OLIS bill-history logs (fetched directly, not summarized secondhand) show the first legislative-day action on both a House bill (HB 4084) and a Senate bill (SB 1586) dated 2-2 (i.e. 2026-02-02), and show SB 1586 marked 'In committee upon adjournment' on 3-6 (2026-03-06); no later action on any 2026 bill was found, so sine die for the 2026 Regular Session is confirmed as 2026-03-06. Disposition rule: any bill not passed by both chambers and enrolled/signed by 2026-03-06 is dead for the 2025-2026 biennium; Oregon does not carry an individual bill number into the next (odd-year) regular session as the same bill. Separately, the 2025 Regular Session (odd-year long session) adjourned sine die on 2025-06-27, per OLIS history rows for the two still-pending 2025 bills below, each marked 'In committee upon adjournment' dated 6-27 (2025-06-27); those bills likewise died at that adjournment and were not reintroduced under the same number in 2026.
